title: Analytic joint metric inference and stable commitment
question: What relation-level distributions and identifiable predictions follow from a continuous joint Gaussian metric posterior with one persistent subject-level commitment, before any neural implementation or renewed comparison with exposed human responses?
claim_boundary: This is a theory-qualification and prediction-registration study. It uses no neural network, reads no Liu participant response file, performs no human-phenotype parameter fit, authorizes no human collection, and cannot promote JMIC-A or JMIC-P as a human or biological mechanism.

design.prior_scale_rule: Match E[||v||^2]=7*tau0^2 to the squared norm 6/7 of the centered normalized reference ranks (k-3.5)/7.
design.equal_spacing_rule: Rank one persistent continuous draw, center ranks as rank-4.5, and rescale the rank vector to the original draw's L2 norm.
design.sigma_definition: Effective uncertainty of one relation mean after the fixed four presentations; v1 defines no repetition-count learning law.

fixed_task_inputs.magnitude_unit: seven raw gap units equal one model unit

model.prior: v ~ N on 1-perp with covariance tau0^2 I
model.likelihood: dbar | v ~ N(A v, sigma_eff^2 I)
model.posterior_precision: tau0^-2 I + sigma_eff^-2 U^T A^T A U
model.persistent_choice: Draw v_s once from the posterior; retain it for all query pairs and repetitions; p_s(i>j)=sigmoid((v_si-v_sj)/theta_dec).

stage_1.graph_rule: For each episode, draw a random permutation path as a spanning tree, then add uniformly selected unused undirected edges until E is reached; orient every edge from lower to higher integer item id.

cohort_recovery.estimator: Deterministic bounded nonlinear least squares on the 28 pair means a_e and factorial second moments b_e, with equal residual weight and one fixed start (sigma/tau0=0.5, theta/tau0=0.25).

decisions.implementation_status: noninterpretable if any exact equation, task-input identity, numerical accuracy, completeness, or forbidden-input check fails; otherwise qualified
decisions.identification_status: qualified_for_prediction_registration only if every fixed cell has numerical Jacobian rank two, no cell exceeds the weak-condition threshold, and both large-cohort recovery thresholds pass; otherwise qualified_but_weakly_identified
decisions.prediction_status: Report exact identities, directions shared by all nine fixed cells, and parameter-dependent effects separately. No prediction result is human rescue.
decisions.no_selection: Run and report all nine fixed parameter cells. Do not select a cell by bimodality, morphology, or similarity to existing human results.

forbidden_inputs: participant response CSV or trial table
